FULL TEXT:
No: OJEE / 0705 DATE: 19.11.2026
REPORTING NOTICE FOR ALL CANDIDATES PARTICIPATED IN
STRAY VACANCY ROUND BAMS/BHMS COUNSELLING
It is to inform all the candidates who have got new allotment in Stray Vacancy round
of BAMS/BHMS counselling must report at OJEE Office, Gandamunda, Khandagiri,
Bhubaneswar for physical reporting with all original documents (All Marksheets/
Certificates/ CLC/ TC/ SLC) & one set of photocopies on 21.11.2026, 10.30 AM to 12.00
NOON positively, to complete other formalities of admission process. If any candidates
failed to report on above mentioned date & time, then he/she will be debarred from
participating in any further Stray Vacancy round(s) of counseling. Further, all the
candidates are advised to follow/complete the below mentioned steps before reporting at
OJEE Office, Gandamunda, Bhubaneswar as per the schedule mentioned above.
A. STEPS:
 Candidates have to choose “FLOAT/FREEZE” as willingness for further consideration in
Stray vacancy rounds (if any).
 Admission Fees must be paid online (using respective login id) if failed to paid online for
any reason then it can be paid by demand draft. In case of demand draft, it should be in
favour of “OJEE” drawn at any Nationalised bank payable at Bhubaneswar. The Name
and NEET Application number of the candidate are to be mentioned on back side of the
draft and the draft is to be submitted at OJEE office at the time of reporting.
 Candidates are required to bring all certificates / mark sheets and other required
documents in original (with another set of photocopies) during provisional admission.
 On successful verification of all documents & deposit of prescribed admission
fees/submission of Nativity Certificate and CLC in original, the candidate will receive
Final admission letter from OJEE Office, only after then the candidates can report to
their respective allotted colleges to complete the other formalities of admission at
college/institute.
 Either the candidate alone or with only one of his / her guardians, should come with the
demand draft and all other necessary documents, to the OJEE Office on the scheduled date
and time to complete the formalities of provisional admission.
Sd/-
Chairman, OJEE
ODISHA JOINT ENTRANCE EXAMINATION – 2026
(OJEE – 2026)
